candidates.prompt: One SQUARE flat software icon on white for writing into a tag buffer a value of datatype F32. Across the TOP place exactly F32 in HUGE BOLD BLACK characters with large WHITE GAPS between each character. No other text, no shadows. Below the type show a large BLUE rectangular buffer and a bold ORANGE horizontal arrow pointing TOWARD the buffer. The arrow must clearly show data going into the buffer. Center the entire design within the square.
